body.h: Everyone passes four count. At the start the jugglers stand in the trapeze formation. During the pattern Anne and Daniel walk clockwise around one square, and Ben and Clare walk clockwise around another square. When you are in the trapeze formation, you pass with the person diagonally opposite you.
Here's the causal diagram for the pattern:
There are other ways of combining pistons and trapeze.
